rows.en: (Gary-sensei's got a pretty good side to him.)

(I was told 'in front of the Sky Gate' again today,
but...)

Yes. But Sensei, if it's the Sky Gate,
then don't tell me...
Yep, that's exactly it!

What, we get to see them again?
Fire Bomber's...
rows.notes: Both genders. Trails off as the Japanese does.

rows.en:
Just kidding. Obviously they're not on today.
Today I wanted to ask how much you've looked
into Fire Bomber since then!
Huh... oh... understood...

Ohh~ So you really did dig into all kinds of stuff.
I'm impressed, I'm impressed.
No, I think I've still got a long way to go...

Right. Get to where you can at least
talk shop with me!
Yes, I'll do my best!
(Gary-sensei really knows his stuff...)
No, I think I've still got a long way to go...
(Gary-sensei really knows his stuff...)

(The artificial island today...
I wonder what we're doing...)

Hey!...
Wait, what's with you, dressed like that...
rows.notes: Both genders. The player is in normal clothes.

rows.en:
Well, Sensei, you're the one who showed up
in a swimsuit out of nowhere...

You come to a place like this, it's straight into
a swimsuit! C'mon, the sun, the waves
and the women are calling to us!

Geez, you're no fun at all.
Come on, hurry up and get changed!
Oh, okay.
Alright, there you are.

Yes!
Swimsuits really do feel great in a place like this!
Right? Right?
Yeah! So, what are we doing today...

You idiot! You come to a place like this
and ask me that?

Listen up.
In a place like this, you do whatever you feel like.

Eat some good food, sure.
Get into some water sports, sure.
Chat up some hot girls, sure. Follow your instincts!
I see, you're right!

Well then, I'm gonna go 'communicate' with that
group over there. You do your own thing!
rows.notes: Both genders. Quotes added to 'communicate' for Gary's euphemism; the Japanese has none.

rows.en: Huh? Oh, okay...
(He's just here for the women after all, isn't he...)
Haah~ Just lying here feels so nice...
Alright, let's do this.
Huh, that's Sensei's voice. What's going on?

Listen up.
Whoever wins this beach volleyball game
gets first dibs!
Whoa, something weird is going on...

Hey, \p!
Get over here, we're starting!

Wait, I got put on his team without anyone
even asking me...

Put your back into it!
You know what happens to your grades
if we lose, right?!
Wh... But that's...
Y-yes!
(We somehow pulled it off...)

(Then again, it kinda feels like Sensei did
pretty much all of it himself...)

Yeah, nice work.
That's my student for ya.

More importantly, what exactly were you
betting on?

Hm, well, that's, uh...
the contact info of those cuties over there...
rows.notes: Both genders. 'onna no ko-chan-tachi': doubly cutesy 'girls', rendered 'cuties'.

rows.en: (Women again...)
You say something?
Huh? The cuties are gone... Aw, dammit...

Well, guess these things happen sometimes.
Hahaha...

(A lot happened, but it was fun.
He's kinda like a big bro, I guess.)

(The artificial island today...
I wonder what we're doing.)
Oh, okay. No peeking, though!

You idiot! A brat like you isn't even worth
peeking at.

Eat some good food, sure.
Get into some water sports, sure.
Chat up some hot guys, sure. Follow your instincts!
(Jeez, he's just here for the women after all...)
Phew, just lying here feels so nice...
Huh, that's Sensei's voice. I wonder what's up?
Something weird is going on...
(We somehow managed to win...)
(Women again, he says...)

(A lot happened, but it was fun.
He's kinda like a big brother, I guess.)

(Off to the artificial island with Gary-sensei
again today!)

Hey, glad you made it!
Already changed into your swimsuit, too.
You're raring to go!
Yes, I'm totally ready to have fun!

Alright! We're going all out!
Follow me!
Phew~ Even I'm worn out now...
Yeah... I'm pretty worn out too...

But that going-all-out spirit? Not bad at all!
That's how it's gotta be when you play!
Yes, got it!
Alright, then let's cut loose a bit more!
What?! No way...
(Gary-sensei's energy is bottomless...)

(Off to the artificial island with Gary-sensei
again today!)
(Gary-sensei's energy is bottomless...)

uncertain: c05350: added quotes around 'communicate' to carry Gary's obvious euphemism (he is going to hit on a group); no quotes in the Japanese.
c05367/c05370: 'onna no ko-chan-tachi' (girls + cutesy -chan) rendered 'those cuties'.
c05344: shared with Klan in frd_kln_006 (not yet translated); 'Right? Right?' kept neutral.
